commitResults.messageTitle: Fix docs issues found in beta testing
commitResults.messageBody: The DG manual test for edit after find now expects the index-change note the app prints. UG known issue 2 now describes the startup warnings that Java 25 prints on every launch. findAlexDavidResult.png is retaken so it shows the Spotter window icon.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add full stops to length errors and raise phone limit
commitResults.messageBody:
Every other message ends with a full stop, but the name and phone
length errors did not. The 50-character phone limit also rejected
three labelled numbers, which the UG encourages, so raise it to 100.

commitResults.messageTitle: Fix cancelsession manual test and note same-name limit
commitResults.messageBody:
The DG manual test quoted an old cancelsession message, and the UG
did not explain that two clients cannot share a name. Quote the real
message and add a workaround note to the UG and DG.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add name lookup and phone warning to use cases
commitResults.messageBody:
UC08 and UC09 now cover booking or cancelling by client name, and
UC03 covers the shared-phone warning that edit shows, as UC01 does.

commitResults.messageTitle: Document the missing space before a prefix
commitResults.messageBody:
A one-word name typed straight into the next prefix is saved as part of
the name. Rejecting it would also reject valid names such as Tan/Lim,
so the UG states the limitation and the DG proposes a warning.

commitResults.messageTitle: Say a blank client name is empty
commitResults.messageBody:
add n/ and edit 1 n/ listed every allowed name character. They now
give the same message as session n/: Name cannot be empty.

commitResults.messageBody:

commitResults.messageTitle: Align partial-name search with Unicode case rules
commitResults.messageBody:
Lowercasing dotted Latin I expands it and makes an accepted name fail
case-insensitive search. Compare normalized substrings using the same
Unicode case rules as full-name lookup while preserving accents and
literal punctuation. Add regression coverage and guide examples.

commitResults.messageTitle: Persist changes to exercise display spelling
commitResults.messageBody:
Case-insensitive exercise identity caused spelling-only replacements
to look unchanged to automatic saving. Compare exact display spelling
for record equality and hashing while retaining case-insensitive entry
identity. Verify capitalization and apostrophe updates through reload.

commitResults.messageTitle: Accept apostrophes inside client email local parts
commitResults.messageBody:
A straight apostrophe in a client email must be preserved rather than
removed or substituted. Extend the shared validator while keeping the
existing domain rules. Cover add, edit and reload and update the guides.

commitResults.messageTitle: Clarify the scope of performance log diagnostics
commitResults.messageBody:
Command diagnostics omit client names, but input and result logging
can still include names and contact details. Distinguish those sources
in the developer guide so the complete log is described accurately.
